rationale: Avoid a Ukrainian gloss that can imply a shared border; preserve simple spatial proximity.
Naturalize the product struggling in the market.
Replace calqued “bring negotiations to an agreement” with successfully concluding negotiations.
Use mastery/skill rather than physical strength for pianists.
Include bending and refraction of light or waves.
Express incitement as an action rather than a permanent personal label.
Correct Ukrainian government for legally prescribed punishment.
共同出資 means joint capital investment, not any shared financing.
確かな成果 is better rendered as tangible/solid results.
Naturalize heightened vigilance regarding storm surge.
Remove an unstated cause/rural-only assumption and broaden 宿泊業界 beyond hotels.
呼びつける is a direct sharp summons, not a request to summon via an intermediary.
